notes: Each series has a new theme. The page does not announce the next series.
name: Enoch Pratt Youth Collective (EPYC)
what_you_do: Join a short themed series at a Pratt library branch to earn service learning hours and build skills. Fall 2026 theme is sewing.
who_can_apply: Baltimore City teens in grades 6 to 12. Space in each group is limited.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications have closed. Groups meet Oct 1 to Nov 24, 2026. The next themes and dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the Pratt Library page when a new series opens. Not open now.
